headlines: {town} Dance Ends with an Unexpected Duet
Two Rivals Call a Truce on the Dance Floor
bodies: {A} and {B} arrived at the town dance determined to avoid one another. When a partner dance left them paired, both finished the number and agreed to suspend their quarrel.
The final tune at the town dance brought longtime rivals {A} and {B} together. They managed the steps, exchanged a bow, and left their disagreement at the door.
{A} offered a hand to rival {B} during the last dance. Both accepted applause and agreed that one pleasant evening need not be their last.

headlines: Dance Floor Becomes a Disputed Border
Rivals Turn a Dance into a Public Quarrel
Last Tune Ends Early After Argument
bodies: {A} and {B} disputed who had stepped on whose foot at the town dance. Their argument drowned out the final tune, and both were asked to leave.
A partner dance briefly paired rivals {A} and {B}, then unpaired them rather loudly. Organizers ended the music while the two argued over a misplaced heel.
The last dance stopped after {A} and {B} traded accusations about deliberate foot-stamping. Witnesses agreed only that neither behaved gracefully.

items.era_notes: In the 1950s favor a hall dance; in the 2020s favor a community dance. Keep music generic and do not imply romance.

headlines: Lost Recipe Box Returned with Cards in Order
{A.last} Returns a Box of Handwritten Recipes
Recipe Cards Find Their Way Home
bodies: {A} found a recipe box beside the road and returned it to {B}, whose name appeared inside the lid. {B} said the stained cards mattered more than any new cookbook.
A box of handwritten recipes lost on {street} was returned by {A} to {B}. Every card was accounted for, including one with measurements written in spoonfuls of uncertain size.
{B} recovered a lost recipe collection after {A} spotted a name inside its wooden box. The reunion ended with thanks and a lengthy explanation of which cards needed salt corrections.

headlines: Rain Spares the Box but Ruins the Recipes
Returned Recipe Box Holds Blurred Memories
Finder Pays to Dry a Waterlogged Keepsake
bodies: {A} paid to have a roadside recipe box carefully dried before returning it to {B}. The handwritten cards remained unreadable, though {B} thanked the finder for trying.
A recipe box found in a rain-filled gutter reached {B} through the efforts of {A}. Drying expenses came out of the finder's pocket, but the ink could not be recovered.
{A} returned a rain-damaged recipe box to {B} after paying for drying materials. The cards were beyond reading, and the two sat quietly while {B} sorted them.

items.era_notes: Use handwritten cards in every decade; do not imply the recipes belonged to a deceased relative.

items.text: They say {A} is secretly learning to whistle the tune that {B} always requests at dances.
variants: I hear {A} is practicing that tune for {B}; a little effort can be a lovely present.
{A} is supposedly learning to whistle a tune for {B}.
If {A} is only out for a walk, why does everyone say the same three notes keep following {A.him}?

items.text: Word is {A} charges customers at {shop} for replacement parts that were only cleaned.
variants: I hope that talk about {A} billing for old parts at {shop} can be cleared up with the receipts.
They say {A} cleans old parts at {shop} and bills them as new.
Has anyone asked {A} to show the discarded parts at {shop}, or do those supposedly vanish too?

items.text: I hear {A} reads the tiny print on seed packets aloud for {B} and accepts payment only in beans.
variants: They say {A} helps {B} read the seed packets; I like that the wages can grow.
{A} supposedly reads seed labels for {B} in exchange for beans.
How many beans does {B} owe {A} now, if the whole planting guide was part of the bargain?

items.text: People say {A} hears a train whistle from the river whenever the church clock stops.
variants: I hear {A} notices a whistle when the clock stops; sound does travel strangely over water.
{A} supposedly hears a train down by the river when the church clock fails.
Why does {A} hear that whistle only when nobody can agree what time it is?

items.text: They say {A} taught {B} to play checkers while quietly allowing a winning move every game.
variants: I hear {A} has been letting {B} win at checkers; kindness can sting when it gets explained in public.
Has {B} noticed those convenient openings from {A}, or is everyone else supposed to keep admiring the victories?

warm: For me? I will find a good place for it.
You remembered. That means a great deal.
Come sit a minute so I can thank you properly.
I was having a plain sort of day. You have improved it.
I appreciate the trouble you took.
Well, look at that. Thank you for thinking of me.
curt: I appreciate it. I am just poor at showing it.
You did not have to. Thanks.
I will take care of it.
All right, you have caught me without a speech. Thank you.
